## Baseline decision comes first

Before editing any access code, capture the actual production gate-expander native release lowering at the approved base with `cargo rustc --locked --release -p gate-expander --lib -- --emit=asm,llvm-ir`, isolated target directory, normal x86-64-v3 configuration, exact toolchain/profile/source/command/status. Locate production Gate process/run_segment instantiations and the inline gate_block access region; unrelated Lane probes do not count. Record whether DualMono still executes partner access and whether equal cross-plane taps still execute duplicate access. A lack of a standalone gate_block symbol is expected under inline(always): inspect mapped callers/IR, not fabricated missing-symbol counts.

Reuse #475's baseline source-mapping/production-caller approach. If shipped LTO makes the region uninspectable, an explicitly supplemental LTO=false capture is allowed only identically for baseline and candidate; label its limits. #475's scalar/simd128 disassembly provenance preserves complete decoded function blocks and actual object identities; reuse its successful decoder procedure on existing Wasm corpus artifacts when qualifying the eventual candidate. Do not credit a bad-magic/failed decode, or source stores as executed loads. #499 was populated-state correctness repair and generated no new lowering; its useful lesson is priming beyond latency, not a second lowering tool.

Decision record before implementation: (a) both avoidable access cases survive in identifiable production lowering -> one issue may implement both; (b) only one survives -> freeze only that arm and record the other as an honest compiler-eliminated/null result; (c) neither survives -> no access rewrite justified for performance, retain the null and seek owner ruling on DYN2 closure/disposition; (d) lowering is inconclusive -> state exactly what mapping is missing and obtain a bounded ruling before implementation, not an assumed benefit. No projected speedup or timing claim follows from any of these outcomes.

## One closable access outcome, conditional on baseline

Both candidate cases share one access helper/classification and the same caller/ring invariants, so they fit one issue rather than two prerequisites: DualMono needs only each channel's own tap; linked modes with tapL[lane]==tapR[lane] for every active lane can reuse the opposite own vector. Equal cross-plane taps may be ragged across tracks. Linked unequal taps keep the original four gathers. Classify once per actual segment, not once per frame or in a persistent cache. Pass the immutable metadata link decision through private GateArgs/run_segment as needed; leave channel_step arithmetic unchanged. Do not add uniform-row copying, per-lane branch dispatch, shared multiband code or a general detector framework.

Preserve main versus connected detector source, write-before-read including zero tap, each channel's own offset for BOTH input planes, wrapping u32 subtraction/addition and power-of-two mask, dry delay, cursor, link Maximum/Average law and arithmetic order, ramp split, latency, rings and serialized state. Inactive width padding does not classify. Recompute after restore/reset/copy via existing segment entry, with no new serialized field. Corpus pins and tolerances stay immutable.

## Path-based evidence, not static family counts

Scalar disconnected: selected process-scalar-disconnected.ll lines483–503 compute comparisons of the two channels' link coefficients. Their later uses at668–674 are selects in detector arithmetic, not branches skipping partner reads. The `.us` loop choice at514/545 is `injected.cond1160.not = icmp ugt` of the two ring slice lengths; it does not specialize DualMono. On the valid equal-length-ring route, bounds-success blocks590–602 perform right-at-left-index and left-at-right-index reads together with the two own reads. The other length version1014–1017 also retains all four. The non-ramping segment likewise repeats the valid detector accesses (1834 onward and its alternative), so this is not merely a ramp-only artifact.

The scalar assembly confirms these are actual memory operands, not only LLVM source bookkeeping: process-scalar-disconnected.s1137/1140/1143/1147 loads the two source planes at the two distinct index registers. These precede link coefficient selection around1337–1352. Nearby1133/1134 are dry-path reads and are NOT counted as detector accesses. The earlier conditionals are bounds/ramp progression, not link-mode elimination. Thus normal valid DualMono still reaches partner accesses; in linked equal-tap cases the two index registers can hold the same runtime index without any equality-based reuse arm.

Scalar connected: process-scalar-connected calls the emitted run_block. Its complete run-block-scalar-connected.ll unswitch predicates at122/159/196/233 and3066–3087 compare main/detector/input/sidechain lengths. These are not link-mode or cross-plane-tap-equality specialization. Valid branch330–339 has all four detector values; link coefficient loads/comparisons and selects occur later404–412 and568–576. Later non-ramping length versions3155–3164 onward retain the same distinct accesses. This maps the connected scalar case through its actual caller rather than assuming the short process wrapper is the kernel.

Native W8: complete process-bank-w8.ll enters the segment loop directly at202, performs write/dry/bounds checks, then follows the lane gather chain beginning741–777 and repeated per active lane. The final lane's own/partner loads at279–281 finish that chain before detector/link arithmetic. The controlling branches are bounds checks, not coefficient masks; vector link results are used by selects. Assembly preserves the corresponding source/index memory operands. There is no equal-cross-plane-tap guard or runtime reuse arm. Both DualMono own-only and linked equal-index opportunities therefore survive for the supported native bank instantiation as well.

Emitted W4 caller evidence is consistent with the four-access shape, but it is ONLY emitted native monomorphization evidence. Public native W4 execution is unavailable under the standing contract; do not claim its qualification or a W4 speedup. No AArch64 or Wasm lowering conclusion is drawn from this native capture. Supported scalar/W8 findings justify branch(a); no native supported-instantiation null was identified. This is still no statement about cycles, cache misses, wall time or net benefit after adding classification.

## Unchanged DSP and research authority

The accepted gate algorithm, coefficient/update rules, domains/units/smoothing, reset/recovery and numerical limits remain those of [the gate brief](https://github.com/misofm/engine/blob/main/.github/ISSUE_SPECS/BRIEFS/014-gate-expander.md), its [reset/restore closure](https://github.com/misofm/engine/blob/main/.github/ISSUE_SPECS/048-launch-gate-reset-restore-and-recovery-proof.md) and [gate audit amendments](https://github.com/misofm/engine/blob/main/.github/ISSUE_SPECS/089-audit-miso-engine-gate-expander.md). Detector magnitude is abs(own) for DualMono, max(abs(own),abs(partner)) for Maximum, and 0.5*abs(own)+0.5*abs(partner) in that order for Average, with both planes read at the observing channel’s tap. The frozen hysteretic hard-knee curve is capped to [-range,0] dB and uses the existing attack/release gain recurrence and fast log/exp rules; #534 changes none of that arithmetic. Fixed latency is Fs/100 integer samples at the four launch rates, bypass preserves it, and tail remains Finite(0). Existing parameter units/domains and bounded smoothing, input sanitation, recursive-state denormal handling and nonfinite recovery are unchanged.

Research provenance is the existing [dynamics note](https://github.com/misofm/engine/blob/main/dsp-research/dynamics.md) and [primary bibliography](https://github.com/misofm/engine/blob/main/dsp-research/BIBLIOGRAPHY.md), particularly REISS-COMP for detector/gain/time-constant analysis and SMITH-SASP for delay/state foundations. These support existing DSP components, not a claimed performance result or an externally mandated gate preset. Existing oracle/conformance/determinism/state/identity fixtures remain the sound-correctness authority for this access-only change. Benchmark invocations are zero; no completed human listening is claimed or newly required by this bit-preserving access scope. ## Consolidated blockers and exact repair

1. Fix the linked-equal law in gather_detector. DualMono may supply own words for ignored partners: [LL,LL,RR,RR]. LinkedEqual MUST supply [LL,RR,RR,LL] after only the two own source reads. They cannot share the current unconditional assignments. Retain unchanged channel_step arithmetic and the original unequal mapping [left(iL),right(iL),right(iR),left(iR)]. Update comments claiming both partner arguments are ignored; that is true only in DualMono. Keep metadata-derived segment classification, active-lane equality, no persistent cache, ring source/write-before-read/wrapping/index behavior and existing state/resource/pin contracts.

2. Repair the same private oracle instead of adding a new harness. Expected semantics and expected route must be frozen by the test case's declared link mode/tap relation, not derived from classify_detector_access or the helper's returned route. For Maximum/Average, compare ALL four actual input words with the independent old mapping; for DualMono compare both actual own words and the consumed detector law without demanding the obsolete partner loads. Put old-word comparisons before the mechanism assertion so the retained bypass mutation can demonstrate unchanged bits followed by failure of the same positive route assertion. Explicitly assert expected classification independently, but do not let that substitute for actual branch-route evidence.

3. Correct the finite access populations. The current “unequal” array starts0 and the left array starts0, so width1 never exercises unequal cross-plane taps. Give W1 genuinely different active offsets and include the linked unequal fallback. Retain equal ragged, zero-tap, physical and u32 wrap, inactive padding and W1/W4/W8 cases already frozen. The purported ignored-partner mutation changes source slot0 while now3/tap2 reads slot1; it proves nothing. Use unequal left/right taps and change actual old cross-partner indices while preserving both own-read locations, then confirm the consumed DualMono result is unchanged. Do not introduce NaNs at unrelated slots and call that access proof.

4. Finish the already frozen evidence, which has not yet been implemented. Add the one non-palindromic identity profile to the existing public scalar/W8 test so linked unequal behavior is real; retain the equal profile and all three modes. Complete any necessary one bounded populated restore/reset/copy next-render classification case through existing state helpers, priming beyond latency and checking actual PCM/full payload rather than startup silence. Preserve existing connected scalar, corpus, oracle, conformance/allocation and state regressions. Perform ONE deliberate actual optimized-dispatch-to-fallback mutation, retain exact diff/command/status, demonstrate the same positive mechanism assertion fails after bit equivalence, restore and pass. Then capture candidate actual production lowering with baseline toolchain/profile/ISA and honest route/access conclusions. No public fixture/state, mutation or candidate lowering was completed in Luna's stopped tranche and none may be claimed from its private-test PASS.

## Public wrapper and corpus scope

Keeping the existing public gate_block signature as a conservative four-read wrapper around the shared private body is compatible and avoids breaking external callers that provide arbitrary coefficient vectors. Production PreparedGate::run_segment already selects the private optimized body using immutable metadata, so this does not by itself invalidate the production scope. Do not infer a uniform LinkMode from one lane of an arbitrary public GateCoef vector merely to make the wrapper optimize.

However, existing corpus.rs calls the compatibility wrapper twice. Its pinned scalar/SIMD replay remains valuable unchanged arithmetic/fallback evidence, but is NOT optimized-route execution evidence. State that limitation candidly. The new private mechanism oracle and actual public PreparedGate identity/state tests must establish candidate routes; candidate native/Wasm lowering must identify the actual PreparedGate caller, not credit an unchanged fallback corpus symbol as the optimized kernel.
